how_the_model_url_was_found: Pattern of limitations #18 / L24, /download/models/lib/mje253.lib: 200, application/octet-stream, 996 bytes (not the 303722-byte soft 404). The header was then read (limitations #20): '.MODEL Qmje253 pnp' - the right part and polarity.

limits_read_with_their_conditions.note: Same table as the NPN (same document, rendered pages 2 and 4 checked). Conditions that matter here: hFE 40 min / 180 max at 200 mA, VCE 1 V (the PNP model sits at 45.1, 12.8 % above the minimum); fT 40 MHz min at 100 mA, 10 V, ftest 10 MHz; C_ob 50 pF max at 10 V, 0.1 MHz (Fig. 7: PNP ~17 pF); V_CEO 100 V; V_EBO 7.0 V; R_thJC 8.34 C/W, R_thJA 83.4 C/W, TJ max 150 C. Nothing is specified at the follower's 20 mA.

spice_model.status: FOUND, served by the manufacturer, and PROVEN to load and run in ngspice 47 (no warnings).
spice_model.authorship_declared_in_the_file: Same MODPEX / Symmetry Design Systems header as the NPN, 'Model generated on Jan 22, 03', PSpice format.

spice_model.oddity_left_as_served: VJC = 0.0329 V (a usual junction has 0.4-0.75 V): the collector-base capacitance collapses with reverse bias faster than a normal junction. At VCB = 10 V the model reproduces the datasheet (C_ob 19.7 pF against ~17 pF in Fig. 7). BF = 54: a low-gain PNP.
